meta.matching: Exact organization name as printed on each list (src/orgs.ts signatory field).
meta.note: Signing is a voluntary public promise, not an audit or a certification. Not signing says nothing about practice; many companies are not eligible (the EU code covers providers of general-purpose AI models).
